## How it was checked

- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm test`, `npm run build` and `npm run docs` pass
- [ ] Tests cover the change (route, screen or unit tests)
- [ ] Platforms tried by hand: iOS / Android / web
- [ ] Maestro flows run (`npm run e2e:ios`) if a screen or a user journey changed
- [ ] New user-visible text is in `src/lib/i18n/en.ts` and `tr.ts`
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under Unreleased
